name: Frito-Lay Mild Cheddar Cheese Dip (Smooth Can)
whyItWorks: A completely smooth, seedless, non-spicy processed cheese dip. Contains 0g fiber and zero peppers or onions; provides comforting savory flavor for pretzels when in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve slightly warm or room temperature. Take a lactase enzyme tablet if lactose sensitive.
